description: Second hand-label pass on the 25 held-out traces the new pipeline shows to the player (agent-made, needs a human spot check). Labeled by reading the original Memory, the Final Fuzz and the shown text. faithful = a readable reconstruction that keeps who, what, where and the outcome of the original; wording may change. unfaithful = readable, but swaps or invents people, objects or events (e.g. librarian -> mother, gate -> fence, invented carousel). echo_fuzz = no reconstruction: the shown text is the Fuzz itself, mostly stars, often cut short. Held-out traces are from allam-2-7b, not the production Qwen 7B.
